title: Study design and evaluation boundaries
legend: GDSC2 continuous drug-response AUC and CCLE transcript-per-million expression were used for development across eight prespecified compounds. Cell-line identities were grouped when constructing repeated nested cross-validation folds; all supervised candidate selection, representation construction, and model tuning were restricted to the relevant training folds. Eight model arms comprised a tissue reference, a strong 2,000-gene expression model, and two candidate-selection rules crossed with expression, within-sample rank, and gene-pair representations. Full-development models were audited and generated CTRPv2 predictions before external response values were accessed. The development and external evaluations share the CCLE expression source; the external analysis is retrospective cross-screen ranking, not cross-expression-platform or clinical validation.

title: Primary REO-pair versus strong-expression contrast in repeated nested development evaluation
legend: Points show the drug-specific and equal-drug macro difference in Spearman correlation, defined as the response-association gene-pair model minus the strong 2,000-gene expression model, using out-of-fold predictions from five outer folds repeated three times. Bars show family-9 adjusted conditional bootstrap intervals based on the recorded out-of-fold predictions. Positive values favor the gene-pair model. Intervals are conditional on the recorded predictions and do not include a full repetition of feature selection, tuning, and model fitting.

title: Candidate-set representation contrasts and full-development molecular solutions
legend: (A) Within each candidate-selection rule, the difference in Spearman correlation between the full gene-pair representation and expression using the same 200 candidate genes; “MAD” denotes selection by median absolute deviation and “response” denotes training-fold response-associated selection. Bars are family-18 adjusted conditional intervals from the repeated nested evaluation. (B) For each drug and molecular model arm fitted on the full development set, gray denotes zero nonzero molecular coefficients and teal denotes at least one nonzero molecular coefficient. This panel describes the final fitted models, not the frequency of zero solutions across outer folds; nonzero coefficients alone do not establish predictive utility or biological mechanism.

title: Defined leave-one-tissue-out contrasts and locked CTRPv2 cross-screen evaluation
legend: (A) For each drug and each of the ten prespecified held-out tissues, teal marks a defined within-tissue Spearman difference between the response-association gene-pair model and the strong-expression model; gray marks an undefined difference. Counts at the left report the number of defined contrasts out of ten. Only 34 of 80 drug-by-tissue contrasts are defined, so the strict equal-drug macro is undefined. (B) Drug-specific and equal-drug macro differences in external Spearman correlation for the full-development response-association gene-pair model versus the strong-expression model; right-side labels give the number of shared external cell-line groups for each drug. Bars are family-9 adjusted conditional bootstrap intervals based on the locked models and external groups. Three drug-specific differences are exactly zero because both models have zero molecular coefficients. CTRPv2 is a retrospective external screen with the same CCLE expression input, not an independent expression-platform or clinical validation.
